# The Hospitality Doctor (SRK Hospitality Solutions)

> Hotel consulting and hospitality training firm based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, founded by Sanchita Ralhan. It diagnoses what is holding a hotel back across People, Process and Profit, fixes it with on-floor training, SOPs and revenue programmes, and stays for 30 days of follow-through. Tagline: "We don't sell training. We build hotel performance."

## Key facts
- Founder: Sanchita Ralhan (also Sanchita Kapoor Ralhan), 15+ years in luxury hospitality.
- Partner: Rahul Khanna.
- Career brands: The Leela (Mumbai), The Oberoi Group (New Delhi), Shangri-La (Malé and Mumbai), Conrad Maldives, Neemrana, Samode, Suryagarh, Indian Accent.
- Hotels worked with as consultant: Samode (heritage storytelling), Arya Niwas (operational excellence), City Palace Bikaner (operations audit and execution), Blackrock Portfolio (reservations and wedding hotels), Cinnamon Hotels (upselling and revenue), Sangam Farms (pre-opening foundation).
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan. Serves hotels across India, on-property.
- Method: Diagnose (48-hour on-property audit) → Fix (workshops, on-floor coaching, SOPs, playbooks) → Measure (30-day reinforcement, MIS dashboards).
- Every module includes: a hands-on workshop, a leave-behind playbook, SOP documentation, on-floor coaching and 30 days of reinforcement support.

## Track record
- Owner-operator hotel: food cost cut from 36% to 28%; GOP raised from 10% to 15%; managed 70+ staff.
- Shangri-La Mumbai: guest complaints reduced 12%; Guest Delight Score up 7%; training manual named "Best Practice of the Month" across Shangri-La worldwide.
- Oberoi reservations: 15% incremental revenue through chain cross-selling.

## 14 solutions
### People
1. Revenue Mastery Bootcamp — upselling, cross-selling and guest spend
2. Guest Experience Excellence — WOW moments and service recovery
3. The Invisible Manager — supervisor accountability and leadership
4. Leadership Development — communication and team building
5. Comfort Is A Cage — ownership, mindset and confidence
6. New Joiner Integration — reduce attrition, faster integration
### Process
7. The Operational Bible — SOPs, job descriptions and checklists
8. Peak Hour Perfection — task allocation and service flow
9. Pre-Opening Support — systems, training and readiness
10. Weddings & MICE Excellence — banquet and event service
11. Airport Lounge Experience — high-volume service excellence
### Profit
12. Revenue Management Excellence — pricing, distribution and forecasting
13. MIS & Dashboards — reporting and performance tracking
14. Hotel Leasing & Management — end-to-end operational oversight
